findings.message: The shared correction-handling skill directs Codex and Gemini to persist user preferences in Claude’s configuration, so those tools may repeat the same mistakes in later sessions. install_tool() installs this skill into every selected tool’s skills directory, and INSTRUCTIONS.md.template requires invoking it after user corrections. Its destination table nevertheless specifies ~/.claude/AGENTS.md for cross-project preferences and ~/.claude/projects/*/memory/MEMORY.md for remembered context.

The documented manual installation commands reference paths removed by this change and no longer install the required shared instructions. The diff moves agents/, skills/, AGENT-PERSONA.md.template, and USER-PERSONA.md.template from src/user/.claude/ to src/user/.agents/. README.md still copies them from their previous paths, and its template-copy instructions omit the new INSTRUCTIONS.md and CLAUDE-EXTENSIONS.md dependencies.
